title: Senior Manager – Product & Lifecycle Management
description:
****Job Summary****
The Senior Manager – Product & Lifecycle Management will lead a consolidated capability bringing together Kitting
  
  
Operations and Product Support / Business Operations. The role will build a cohesive, scalable organization with strong
  
  
operational delivery, stakeholder management, talent development, process integration and continuous improvement
  
  
across product and lifecycle-related activities.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Senior Manager Product and Lifecycle Management**
****About Medline****
Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.com.
  
  
**Medline India**
Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.
  
  
****Job Summary:****
Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.
  
  
Business scope
  
  

* Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.
* Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.
* Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.
* Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

****Responsibilities:****
Product and lifecycle accountabilities
  
  
Kitting and lifecycle operations
  
  

* Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.
* Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.
* Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

Product data and documentation
  
  

* Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.
* Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.
* Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

Technical and product development support
  
  

* Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.
* Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

Commercial and supplier enablement
  
  

* Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.
* Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.
* Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

Transformation and leadership accountabilities
  
  
Business analytics and decision support
  
  

* Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.
* Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

Automation and AI
  
  

* Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.
* Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.
* Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

People and capability leadership
  
  

* Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.
* Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.
* Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through change, resolve competing priorities and maintain employee engagement as scope and ways of working evolve.

Global partnership and operational governance
  
  

* Establish one service catalogue, demand and capacity process, performance scorecard and escalation framework. Lead business reviews with global stakeholders and align resources to business value, risk and service commitments.
* Manage delivery quality, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, controls, budget and continuity within delegated authority. Maintain current procedures, training records, access controls and reliable backup coverage.
* Shape a phased capability roadmap and lead new scope discovery, transition planning, knowledge transfer and stabilization. Define acceptance criteria, service ownership and controls before assuming additional work.

****Work Experience & Required Skills:****

* Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience across product operations, product lifecycle management, supply chain, technical business operations or global capability environments, with substantial responsibility for complex delivery portfolios.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers or team leaders across multiple specialist teams, including performance management, succession development, organizational change and global stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of product and component data, bills of materials, lifecycle changes and cross-functional dependencies. Relevant experience may come from medical devices, healthcare products or other complex manufactured-product businesses.
* Proven delivery of analytics and automation initiatives with measurable business outcomes. Ability to assess analytical logic, data quality, technology options and benefits rather than relying solely on project status reporting.
* Commercial and operational acumen sufficient to evaluate inventory exposure, cost and margin implications, service trade-offs and the business case for capability expansion.
* Ability to work with senior international stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, communicate complex issues clearly and lead teams through ambiguity.

****Educational Qualification:****

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, operations, business or a relevant discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project management, supply chain or product lifecycle qualifications are useful where supported by delivery experience.
* Preferred exposure includes regulated product documentation, kitting or configurable products, product information management and ERP systems, Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, RPA or AI implementation strengthens the profile.
* Relevant environments in the current scope include SAP, QAD, AS400, PIM, Medpack, NetQuote, Workfront and Smartsheet; expertise in every platform is not required.

****About Medline India:****
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
  
  
****About Medline Industries, LP:****
Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
  
  
At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

**SEO Specialist**

Experience: 1 to 3 years | Location: Wakad, Pune (On-site) | Immediate joiners preferred

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a sharp SEO specialist who learns fast, works smart with AI, and takes ownership of results.

We care more about how quickly you pick things up than how long you’ve been doing this. If you’ve spent a year in SEO and already work faster and better than people with three, we want to hear from you.

At Digiholic, SEO covers the full picture of search: Google rankings, AI Overviews, and how brands show up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. You’ll work across B2B and B2C clients in India, the US and other markets, with direct mentoring from founders who have built SEO results for over two decades.

* SEO performance for your client accounts: rankings, traffic, AI visibility and leads, with KPIs that are yours to hit

* Content direction with the writing team: briefs, topic clusters and refresh plans
* Monthly reports that explain what moved, why, and what you’re doing next
* Using AI tools to work faster, and checking their output so speed never costs accuracy
* Blog uploads and basic website upkeep

* 1 to 3 years in SEO, or less if your work speaks for itself

* Comfort with GSC, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a crawler like Screaming Frog
* Real, daily use of AI tools in your SEO workflow, not just for writing
* Clear communication: you speak up, ask questions, and flag problems early
* The confidence to own a number and explain it when it goes up or down

**Bonus Points If You**

* Have built your own prompts, workflows or automations for SEO tasks
* Have tested ways to get a brand cited in AI search results

**Who This Role Isn’t For**

If you prefer waiting for instructions, this won’t be the right fit. We’re looking for someone who comes to us with what they found, what they think, and what they’ve already tried.

**Why Join Digiholic?**

You’ll own real accounts across industries and countries, learn directly from founders, and grow as fast as your results allow.

Send your resume to andrew@digiholic.in. Start your subject line with
**DIG-SEO-2026**
.

2. *Share one result you owned, with numbers.*

Applications without the subject line or the answers won’t be reviewed.

title: Head of Digital Marketing
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune.

**SUMMARY**

We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Digital Department Head to lead our digital marketing function. This is a full-stack marketer role. Performance Marketing is the core area of expertise, and you will also lead a team across Performance Marketing, SEO, Social Media, and Email Marketing. You will need strong hands-on experience in planning, executing, optimising and scaling digital campaigns. The role combines strategic thinking, analytical expertise, team leadership and client management, with a focus on driving measurable business growth through integrated digital marketing strategies. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Performance marketing & paid media 

Lead the overall performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube, and other relevant advertising platforms. 

Develop and execute paid media strategies focused on lead generation, sales, customer acquisition, ROAS and business growth. 

Own campaign planning, media budgeting, forecasting, audience targeting, funnel strategy and performance optimisation. 

Analyse CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and lead quality to improve campaign efficiency. Identify opportunities to scale campaigns and optimise media spend. 

Oversee campaign tracking, conversion measurement, pixels, analytics, attribution and reporting to ensure data accuracy. 

Lead performance audits, competitor analysis, account restructuring and strategic media planning for new and existing clients. 

Stay current on platform developments, automation, AI-powered optimisation and emerging performance marketing trends. 

SEO & organic growth 

Lead SEO strategy across technical SEO, on-page and off-page optimisation, keyword research and content optimisation. 

Oversee organic traffic growth, keyword rankings, website visibility and organic lead generation. Work with content and development teams to improve website performance, user experience and search visibility. 

Explore emerging opportunities in AI search, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). 

Track SEO performance and recommend data-backed improvements. 

Social media marketing 

Oversee social media strategy, content planning, platform growth and audience engagement across relevant channels. 

Keep organic social activity aligned with paid media objectives. 

Guide the team on content performance, audience growth, reach, engagement and brand visibility. Work with creative teams on performance-oriented creatives, ad formats and content strategies, and spot platform trends worth acting on. 

Email marketing & marketing automation 

Lead email strategies for lead nurturing, customer engagement, retention and conversion. Oversee audience segmentation, campaign planning, automation workflows and personalised communication. Monitor open rates, click-through rates, conversions and unsubscribe rates.

Integrate email marketing effectively with paid campaigns, CRM systems and lead management processes. Team leadership & department management 

Lead and mentor teams across Performance Marketing, SEO, Social Media and Email Marketing. Define team KRAs, KPIs, responsibilities, workflows and performance evaluation frameworks. Allocate resources, manage workloads, and ensure campaigns, reports, audits and strategic plans are delivered on time. 

Establish SOPs, reporting formats, quality checks and optimisation processes. 

Identify skill gaps, drive continuous learning and tool adoption, and build workflows that reduce operational dependency and improve productivity. 

Client management & business growth 

Work closely with clients and account management teams to translate business objectives into effective digital strategies. 

Lead client presentations, performance reviews, strategic discussions, audits, pitches and media plan presentations. 

Communicate performance, business impact, challenges and recommendations clearly to stakeholders. Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and contribute to new business pitches, proposals, digital audits, commercial planning and revenue growth. 

Build strong client relationships through strategic input, transparency and consistent delivery. Analytics, reporting & innovation 

Establish dashboards and reporting frameworks to monitor campaign and department-level performance. Translate data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations, and ensure tracking and reporting are accurate across platforms. 

Evaluate new tools, automation solutions, and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency and productivity. Drive a culture of testing, learning, continuous optimisation, and accountability. 

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

7–8 years of experience in digital marketing, with strong expertise in Performance Marketing. Proven experience managing and scaling campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads. Experience with LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and other paid platforms is preferred. 

Strong understanding of media planning, budgeting, forecasting, conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign analytics. 

Working knowledge of SEO, Social Media Marketing, Email Marketing and marketing automation. Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio and Excel/Google Sheets. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills. 

Experience managing teams, client relationships, multiple accounts and competing priorities. Ability to connect digital marketing metrics to business outcomes and revenue objectives, with a proactive, data-driven, growth-oriented approach. 

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance marketing efficiency and achievement of client/business targets, including improvement in CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rates, ROAS and lead quality, as applicable. 

Growth in qualified leads, conversions, revenue and paid media effectiveness. 

SEO performance, organic traffic growth, rankings and organic conversions. 

Social media growth, reach, engagement and content effectiveness; email engagement, conversions and retention performance. 

Client retention, satisfaction and contribution to account growth. 

Team productivity, delivery timelines, quality of work, achievement of departmental targets, process improvements, reporting accuracy and effective adoption of automation.

title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

Education

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

title: Technology Commercial Support - Growth
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams

Measures of success
  
  

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business-as-usual execution

**Who You Are**
Essential knowledge and capabilities
  
  

* You have expert capability in pricing, financial modelling and commercial analysis
* You demonstrate commercial acumen and a detailed understanding of deal economics, profitability and risk drivers
* You can design and communicate pricing strategies for complex technology opportunities
* You have advanced Microsoft Excel skills and can develop complex financial models, sensitivity analyses and commercial scenarios
* You apply a high level of attention to detail, structured governance and quality assurance
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally with senior internal and customer stakeholders
* You use relevant market and competitor insight to inform pricing decisions
* You can prioritise effectively and manage concurrent work across multiple customers and opportunities
* You demonstrate Vodafone Spirit behaviours
* You apply independent judgement to create tailored commercial approaches rather than relying solely on standard pricing methods

**Experience**

* You have extensive pricing or commercial support experience in IT services, telecommunications or systems integration
* You will typically bring 15 to 18 years of overall professional experience, including 7 to 10 years in senior pricing, bid or commercial roles

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
**Job Description**
The purpose of having a project manager is to coordinate all project activities from initiation to completion, ensuring that objectives are achieved on time, within scope, and budget. They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Project Planning: Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* Team Leadership: Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* Monitoring & Reporting: Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* Problem Solving: Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* Closing the Project: Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

**Skills Required**

* Leadership: Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to various stakeholders.
* Time Management: Skill in managing one’s own time and the time of others to meet deadlines.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Problem-Solving: Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* Negotiation: Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* Budgeting: Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)
* Demand Generation
* Drive lock-in specifications and dilute challenging specs
* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL
* OEM development by application selling. - infrastructure, F&B, Power, Heat treatment, Packaging, OEMs
* Identifying gaps in the current coverage and drive Honeywell acceptance
* Participate in Mutual Action Planning (MAP) discussions with our CP/SI
* Attend Pre-bid and post bid technical meetings and drive Honeywell needs
* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

**Qualifications**
**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.
* Supporting sales campaigns or programs in specific markets or for specific products
* Proven Presentation skills

**Specific Knowledge Required**

* Technical understanding of portfolio, competition and understanding of customer applications is must

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

* Experience with B2B or SaaS content

Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV and portfolio to career@arcsetu.com.

title: Sales & Marketing Coordinator
description:
**VACANCY FOR SALES & MARKETING COORDINATOR**

**About Revata Engineering**

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing company serving the Oil & Gas and other engineering industries. We specialise in high-performance elastomer solutions, industrial sealing products, custom-moulded rubber components and application-specific engineered products.

**About the Position**

We are looking for a
**Sales & Marketing Coordinator**
with a technical background and experience in handling customer enquiries, preparing quotations and coordinating orders. The candidate should be comfortable understanding customer requirements, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, discussing suitable materials and product applications, and working with internal teams to develop appropriate solutions.

The role involves regular interaction with customers in India and overseas, along with close coordination with our Engineering, Production, Quality, Purchase and other departments. The selected candidate will report directly to the Managing Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Enquiries & Technical Coordination**

* Handle customer enquiries and RFQs, including technical and commercial discussions.
* Review drawings, specifications, samples and other customer requirements.
* Identify missing technical details and obtain necessary clarifications from customers.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Design and other departments to evaluate requirements and product feasibility.
* Maintain proper records of customer enquiries and follow-ups.

**2. Material Selection & Application Support**

* Understand customer applications and suggest suitable elastomer and polymer materials such as NBR, HNBR, FKM, FFKM, AFLAS, PTFE, PEEK, etc.
* Discuss application conditions such as pressure, temperature, fluid compatibility and other performance requirements.
* Coordinate with the Engineering, R&D and Laboratory teams for technical recommendations and product development.
* Assist customers in resolving technical queries related to product selection, design and performance.

**3. Quotations & Order Conversion**

* Prepare techno-commercial quotations in coordination with the Engineering, Costing and Production teams.
* Ensure quotations include relevant technical details, pricing, tooling charges, delivery schedules, payment terms and other commercial conditions.
* Follow up with customers on submitted quotations and work towards converting enquiries into orders.
* Handle price negotiations and commercial discussions wherever required.
* Maintain records of quotations, customer responses and order conversion.

**4. Order Processing & Internal Coordination**

* Review customer purchase orders against submitted quotations and agreed terms.
* Verify technical specifications, quantities, prices, delivery schedules and other order requirements.
* Coordinate with Production, Purchase, Quality and other departments for smooth order execution.
* Keep customers informed about order progress, delivery schedules and any changes.
* Coordinate customer approvals, inspection requirements and documentation wherever applicable.

**5. Product Development & Customer Trials**

* Coordinate with Engineering and NPD teams for development of new and customised products.
* Assist in reverse-engineering projects involving customer samples and existing components.
* Follow up on sample development, product trials, testing and customer approvals.
* Collect customer feedback and coordinate necessary improvements with the technical teams.

**6. Customer Relationship Management & After-Sales Support**

* Maintain regular communication with existing customers and develop strong working relationships.
* Handle customer queries, complaints and after-sales requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality and Engineering teams for investigation and resolution of product-related complaints.
* Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely communication with customers.

**7. Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities with existing and potential customers.
* Promote Revata's products and manufacturing capabilities across different industries and applications.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical meetings and product presentations.
* Gather market information, customer requirements and competitor feedback.
* Support business development activities in domestic and international markets.

**8. Sales Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain updated records of enquiries, quotations, orders and customer communications.
* Track pending quotations, customer follow-ups and potential business opportunities.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and updates for management.
* Ensure all relevant information is properly maintained in the company's CRM/ERP system.

**9. Marketing & Exhibitions**

* Assist in organising and participating in trade exhibitions, industrial events and customer meetings.
* Follow up on leads and enquiries generated through exhibitions and marketing activities.
* Support the preparation of company presentations, product brochures and other marketing materials.
* Coordinate with the graphic designer and internal teams for marketing-related activities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Rubber Technology, Petroleum Engineering or a related field.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in technical sales, sales coordination, application engineering or a similar customer-facing role in a manufacturing company.
* Preference will be given to candidates with experience in elastomers, industrial seals, rubber products, engineering components or Oil & Gas equipment.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, technical specifications and dimensional tolerances.
* Basic understanding of elastomer and polymer materials, their properties and industrial applications.
* Good technical understanding with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal engineering teams.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
* Good command of written and spoken English.
* Willingness to travel within India and occasionally overseas for customer visits and exhibitions.

**Additional Preferences**

Candidates having the following experience or knowledge will be preferred:

* Exposure to Oil & Gas equipment, downhole tools, packers, pressure-control equipment and sealing applications.
* Experience dealing with international customers, export enquiries and commercial terms.
* Basic understanding of seal design, material selection and product applications.
* Experience working with CRM or ERP systems.
* Ability to communicate in Hindi and Marathi.

8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Senior Performance Marketing
description:

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Full-time | Pune-based | Mostly remote**

Ink Media is a boutique marketing and design agency based in Pune. We’re looking for an organised, attentive Social Media Manager who can keep client communication clear, content schedules on track and brand accounts running consistently.

You’ll manage day-to-day social media activity for approximately 4–5 clients across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. You’ll work with an Account Manager and Designer, with training, guidance and final creative approval from our Creative Director.

This role requires someone who follows through, pays attention to detail and takes responsibility for getting approved work published correctly and on time.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate with clients through WhatsApp groups, calls and meetings to collect inputs, clarify feedback and follow up on approvals.
* Maintain clear records of feedback, pending approvals, publishing dates and completed work.
* Research competitors, industry activity, platform trends and content references to contribute relevant ideas.
* Support the team in developing content calendars and present approved calendars to clients.
* Schedule and publish approved content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Check captions, creatives, links, tags and formatting before publishing, and verify posts after they go live.
* Monitor comments and DMs, respond using agreed guidance and flag enquiries or issues to the relevant team member.
* Track account and post performance, prepare monthly reports and suggest practical improvements.
* Check content for language accuracy, clarity and consistency, and support caption refinements when needed.
* Use Canva for presentations and simple changes to existing content.
* Attend occasional client-site visits and in-person meetings in Pune.

**What we’re looking for**

* Strong organisation, follow-through and attention to detail.
* Confidence coordinating with clients, understanding feedback and keeping the team informed.
* An excellent command of English to understand briefs, check written content and communicate clearly.
* The ability to communicate comfortably in Hindi and Marathi.
* A working understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube, including publishing and basic platform analytics.
* The ability to research competitors, track published content and prepare clear performance reports.
* Basic Canva skills.
* Reliability and responsiveness during working hours, along with a willingness to learn and apply feedback.

Previous experience managing brand accounts is preferred.
**Strong freshers with relevant work samples and a clear understanding of these responsibilities are also welcome.**

**Working arrangement**

* Candidates must currently live in Pune.
* This is a mostly remote role, with in-person meetings approximately once a week and occasional client-site visits.
* Fixed availability is required during these hours:
* **Monday–Friday:**
  10:30 am–6:30 pm IST
* **Saturday:**
  10:30 am–2:00 pm IST

**What you can expect**

Close collaboration with our Creative Director, support from the team, exposure to varied client projects and opportunities to develop your skills within a positive, open working culture.

**How to apply**

Please submit
**your resume and relevant work samples**
, with working links and any necessary access permissions.

If you have experience, include links to accounts you have managed or supported, briefly explain your responsibilities and share an example content calendar.

Freshers may submit clearly labelled academic or self-initiated work, including a sample content calendar that demonstrates their understanding of managing a brand’s social media presence.

*Applications must include both a resume and relevant work samples. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short call to discuss their work, approach and suitability for the role.*

title: Lead Analyst, Database Marketing

title: Sales And Marketing Intern
description:
Sciverse is an AI-first technology company working across healthcare technology, medical diagnostics, artificial intelligence, software development, and next-generation digital products.

We build innovative products and help businesses turn complex ideas into practical technology solutions. As we expand our customer base in India and international markets, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Intern who can help us identify opportunities, connect with potential customers, and convert conversations into business.

Who are we looking for? We are not looking for someone who simply wants to learn sales theory.
**We want someone who loves communicating, enjoys convincing people, takes initiative, and has the confidence to sell a valuable solution to the right customer.**

**You should be curious, commercially minded, articulate, persistent, and comfortable speaking with founders, business owners, senior executives, and international clients.**

**You do not need to be an expert in every product we sell. You do need the ability to understand a product quickly, identify why a customer might need it, communicate its value clearly, and make a compelling case for buying it.**

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and research potential customers, companies, and business opportunities in India and international markets.
* Generate qualified sales leads through LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, online research, and other channels.
* Initiate conversations with founders, CXOs, business owners, and decision-makers.
* Communicate Sciverse's products and services clearly, confidently, and professionally.
* Understand customer requirements, identify business problems, and position the right solution.
* Conduct initial sales conversations, schedule meetings, follow up with prospects, and help move opportunities through the sales pipeline.
* Prepare introductory emails, proposals, presentations, and other sales materials.
* Maintain accurate lead information, follow-up schedules, and sales activity records in the CRM.
* Research new markets, identify potential business partners, and support international business development.
* Work with the founding team to develop outreach strategies, test sales approaches, and improve conversion rates.
* Take ownership of assigned leads and consistently work toward measurable sales targets.

Essential Requirements

**1. Excellent English communication — mandatory**

**You must have very strong spoken and written English. You should be able to write professional business emails, hold confident conversations, explain ideas clearly, and communicate with international customers without constant assistance.**

**2. Confidence and persuasion**

**You should be comfortable initiating conversations with strangers, handling objections, asking relevant questions, negotiating professionally, and asking for the next step or the sale.**

**3. A genuine interest in selling**

**We value people who enjoy understanding customer needs, creating opportunities, persuading thoughtfully, and closing deals. A willingness to make calls, hear “no,” learn from rejection, and follow up consistently is essential.**

**4. Smart, proactive, and commercially aware**

**You should be able to research a company, understand what it does, identify a potential need, and explain why Sciverse could be relevant to that business.**

**5. Ownership and execution**

**We expect initiative, consistency, accountability, and a results-oriented approach. You should be able to work independently while collaborating closely with the founding team.**

**6. Comfortable with technology**

**You should be willing to learn about AI, software products, digital platforms, healthcare technology, and business solutions well enough to communicate their value to potential customers.**

Languages: A Strong Advantage

Excellent English is compulsory. Knowledge of any additional language that can help us engage customers across international markets will be a significant advantage.

Particularly useful languages include:

* **German**
  — Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and other European markets.
* **French**
  — France, parts of Europe, Canada, and French-speaking African markets.
* **Spanish**
  — Spain and Latin American markets.
* **Arabic**
  — Middle Eastern markets.
* **Japanese**
  — Japan.
* **Mandarin Chinese**
  — China and Chinese-speaking business networks.
* **Portuguese**
  — Brazil and Portugal.
* **Other languages**
  are welcome if you can demonstrate how they could help us expand into new markets.

Language proficiency must be genuine and useful for business communication. An additional language is a bonus, not a replacement for excellent English.

What You Will Gain

* Direct exposure to business development and international B2B sales.
* Opportunities to interact with founders, executives, and decision-makers.
* Practical experience selling AI, software, healthcare technology, and digital solutions.
* Experience in lead generation, prospecting, sales strategy, negotiation, and pipeline management.
* The opportunity to take ownership of real business opportunities and contribute directly to company growth.
* A fast-learning environment where initiative, performance, and measurable results matter.

Who Should Apply?

Students, recent graduates, and aspiring sales professionals who are confident communicators, curious about technology, and motivated to build a career in sales, business development, or international business.

Prior sales experience is an advantage, but it is not mandatory. We are interested in your communication skills, attitude, initiative, ability to learn, and willingness to deliver results.

**At Sciverse, we value people who can turn conversations into opportunities and opportunities into business. If you are confident, curious, persuasive, and ready to learn by doing, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Client Servicing & Social Media Executive | Advertising Agency | Immediate Joiner
description:

Community Reputation & Management

* Proficiency in tools like Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Hootsuite, Buffer, Canva, etc.

Why Join Us?

description:
**Job Posting Title**
Gr 6 / PG 40 – Enterprise IT - Director, EGM Digital Marketing & India, SEA, Japan – Asia
  
  
**Job Description**

* Role: Enterprise IT - Director, EGM Digital Marketing & India, SEA, Japan
* Reporting to: Vaidyanath Subbaraman
* Region: Asia
* Pay grade: Gr 6 / PG 40

Configures, localizes and operates global MarTech platforms for segment-specific campaign execution and consumer engagement to meet the segment's commercial and marketing objectives
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Translate segment B2B/B2C commercial and marketing priorities into technology requirements and delivery commitments
* Localize global MarTech capabilities for segment-specific needs (e.g., campaign workflows, compliance requirements, engagement tooling)
* Own segment digital marketing platform operations, ensuring availability, incident response, and service levels meet the segment's campaign calendar and commercial cadence
* Configure and operate global MarTech platforms provided by Consumer Growth Tech (e.g., web, social, mobile, loyalty) for segment-specific campaign execution and consumer engagement programs
* Represent segment-specific requirements to CGT Head of Digital Marketing Technology, ensuring the global platform roadmap accounts for segment use cases and local market constraints
* Develop segment digital marketing technology business cases, forecasting inputs, and adoption plans to inform CGT investment prioritization
* Govern segment-level data flows between MarTech platforms and segment consumer data sources, ensuring campaign targeting, measurement, and personalization inputs are accurate and compliant with local data privacy requirements and enterprise security and data protection protocols

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:**

* Experience deploying and operating digital marketing technology at segment or regional level within a CPG or consumer-facing organization
* Understanding of how global MarTech platforms are configured and operated at segment level to enable end-to-end marketing execution
* Ability to operate in a matrixed structure, balancing segment-specific commercial priorities with enterprise platform standards
* Familiarity with segment market regulatory and data privacy requirements that shape how marketing technology is operated in the region
* Financial fluency in P&L dynamics, business case development, and OKR/KPIs

**Key Measure of Success**

* Campaign technology readiness — % of planned segment marketing campaigns technically enabled on schedule against the segment marketing calendar
* Segment demand fulfillment — % of segment marketing technology requests delivered against committed intake within agreed timeframes
* Segment marketing platform availability — uptime % and P1/P2 incident count across segment-facing digital marketing platforms

Please note: at this time Kenvue / KC will not be supporting candidates through a Immigration / Green Card / Permanent Residency process.
  
  
Company sponsored relocation is not provided. All interested candidates who are outside of the role’s location options must self-relocate if interested in the role.

About MailEasy

MailEasy is an AI-powered productivity platform focused on simplifying and automating email workflows, CRM processes, and business communication. We build intelligent solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and grow more efficiently.

We’re looking for a
**Creative Marketing Strategist Intern**
with exceptional communication skills, a creative mindset, and a strong interest in marketing, branding, and business growth. This role is ideal for someone who can think strategically, communicate persuasively, generate innovative ideas, and turn those ideas into impactful marketing initiatives.

**1. Marketing Strategy & Growth**

* Develop creative marketing strategies to build brand awareness and generate leads.
* Identify new opportunities to reach target audiences and potential customers.
* Experiment with different marketing channels, campaigns, and growth strategies.

**2. Content Creation & Storytelling**

* Write compelling marketing copy, campaign messages, product descriptions, and promotional content.
* Develop creative storytelling approaches to communicate MailEasy’s value proposition.
* Translate complex AI and technology concepts into clear, engaging messages.

**3. Brand Building & Positioning**

* Help establish and strengthen MailEasy’s brand identity and market presence.
* Develop innovative ideas for brand awareness and audience engagement.

**4. Campaign Planning & Execution**

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns across relevant channels.
* Brainstorm and implement creative marketing initiatives.
* Collaborate with the team to launch campaigns, test ideas, and improve results.
* Take ownership of projects from ideation to execution.

**5. Market Research & Customer Understanding**

* Research industry trends, competitors, target markets, and customer needs.
* Identify potential customer segments and new marketing opportunities.
* Understand customer pain points and translate insights into effective messaging.
* Support the development of go-to-market strategies for MailEasy’s products.

**6. Performance Tracking & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance and audience engagement.
* Analyze results and identify areas for improvement.
* Use data and customer feedback to refine marketing strategies.
* Continuously experiment with new ideas to improve marketing effectiveness.

Mandatory Requirement: Exceptional Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to articulate ideas clearly, confidently, and persuasively.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and professional communication skills.
* Confidence in pitching ideas, explaining strategies, and engaging in discussions.
* Ability to write compelling content that captures attention and communicates value.
* Comfort communicating with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
* A proactive personality with the confidence to express opinions, ask questions, and contribute ideas.

Candidates should be able to explain their thought process, present ideas convincingly, and communicate professionally in real-world business situations.

Who Should Apply?

* Students, recent graduates, and aspiring marketing professionals with an interest in marketing, branding, and growth.
* Creative thinkers who enjoy brainstorming and solving business problems.
* Individuals with strong communication, writing, and presentation skills.
* People who understand social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
* Self-driven individuals who can take initiative and work independently.
* Candidates interested in AI, SaaS, startups, technology, and digital marketing.
* Individuals who are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

Knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, growth marketing, content strategy, design tools, or AI-powered productivity tools is an advantage, but not mandatory.
