title: Head of Performance Marketing & Growth
description:
Meta Ads • Google Ads • Amazon Ads • Quick Commerce
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time \| Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹50,000–₹80,000/month \+ performance incentives
 **up to ₹5 lakh** 




  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **performance marketer who is obsessed with numbers, experiments and growth.** 




**Someone who doesn't just know how to** 
*run Meta Ads* 
 — but understands
 **why an ad wins, why it loses, how many creatives to test, which audiences to explore, when to kill an ad, when to scale it, and how to turn paid acquisition into a predictable growth engine. Meta should be your deepest area of expertise** 
 .
 



 You should have experience scaling a brand or working with an agency where you have managed significant budgets and contributed to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue** 
 or equivalent scale, with a strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, contribution margin and profitability.
 



  





  





 What you'll own:
 



  





 1\. META ADS — THIS IS YOUR CORE JOB
 



 You will own the entire Meta performance engine.
 



 Not just campaign execution.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Campaign architecture and account structure
* Prospecting vs retargeting strategy
* Audience discovery
* Broad vs interest vs lookalike strategies
* Creative testing frameworks
* Hook testing
* Copy testing
* Offer testing
* Landing\-page testing
* Budget allocation
* Campaign scaling
* Retargeting
* Frequency management
* CAC / ROAS optimisation
* Attribution analysis
* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly growth analysis



  





 You should be able to answer questions like:
 



**How many creatives should we launch this week?Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?When do you kill an ad?When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?Why did CPM increase?Why is CTR falling?Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?** 




  





  





 2\. Build a creative testing machine:
 



 You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.
 



 You will decide:
 


* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed



 For example:
 



**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers** 




 should not be random experimentation.
 



 You should be able to build a
 **structured testing matrix** 
 and understand which variable is actually driving performance.
 



  





**3\. Creative Intelligence** 




 You won't just consume creatives.
 



 You'll help
 **create them.** 




 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation



 You should be capable of saying:
 



 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.



**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.



  





**Mandatory Experience** 




 I'd make these requirements quite specific:
 



**Required:** 



* 3–7 years performance marketing experience
* Strong hands\-on Meta Ads experience
* Experience with either a
 **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial advertising budgets
* Experience contributing to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue / GMV**
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV and contribution margin
* Google Ads experience
* Amazon Ads experience
* Quick\-commerce advertising experience
* Canva \+ AI creative tools
* Strong analytical skills
* Competitor research / ad intelligence experience



**Preferred:** 



* Food / FMCG / nutrition / wellness / beauty / D2C experience
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience launching a new product from zero
* Experience working directly with founders
* Basic design/video editing ability
* Strong understanding of landing\-page CRO

Sales \& Marketing Intern

 Internship Type: Remote
   

 About Indux Technology
   

 Indux Technology is a technology\-focused company delivering digital solutions and real\-world technology projects. The internship program is designed to give students and freshers practical exposure, professional work habits, team collaboration, and role\-specific experience while contributing to company initiatives.
   

 About the Internship
   

 We are looking for motivated candidates for the Sales \& Marketing Intern position. This 6\-month internship is intended for candidates who want to build practical skills through real\-world work, guided learning, feedback, and consistent contribution. Support customer acquisition through prospect research, lead generation, outreach, follow\-ups, digital marketing, campaign execution, and sales support.

 As a Sales \& Marketing Intern, you will work with the relevant team to support assigned projects and operational activities. You will be expected to learn quickly, follow professional processes, complete assigned responsibilities, and progressively take greater ownership of your work.

 Identify target customers, industries, companies, and business opportunities.

 Support social media and digital marketing activities that contribute to lead generation.
   

 Research competitors, customer needs, market trends, and new opportunities.
   

 Maintain CRM records and track outreach, follow\-ups, meetings, and outcomes.
   

 Collaborate with sales, marketing, content, design, and technical teams.
   

 Monitor campaign/outreach performance and suggest practical improvements.
   

 Maintain professional communication and represent the company appropriately.
   

 Skills \& Requirements
   

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
   

 Interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology.
   

 Basic knowledge of lead generation, customer acquisition, and digital platforms.
   

 Familiarity with LinkedIn, email, CRM, and social media is preferred.
   

 Good research, follow\-up, organization, and relationship\-building skills.
   

 Confidence to communicate with prospects professionally.
   

 Target\-oriented, proactive, and willing to learn.
   

 Students and freshers are welcome.
   

 Performance Expectations
   

 Consistent completion of assigned tasks with acceptable quality.
   

 Ability to learn from feedback and demonstrate measurable improvement.
   

 Professional communication and timely response to team members.
   

 Reliability, discipline, ownership, and adherence to deadlines.
   

 Positive contribution to team goals and willingness to take initiative.
   

 Role\-specific performance and contribution during the internship.
   

 What You Can Gain
   

 Practical exposure to real\-world projects and professional workflows.
   

 Hands\-on experience relevant to the selected role.

 Guidance, feedback, collaboration, and exposure to cross\-functional teams.

 Interns must maintain confidentiality and must not share company/client information, source code, credentials, documents, or internal data without authorization.

 How to Apply

 hr@induxtechnology.com

title: Product Line Manager - Greases, Maintenance and Power transmission Products
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Position Title:** 
 Product Line Manager, Industrial ISEAM (ISEAM, South\- East Asia \& Middle East)
   

  





**Reports To:** 
 Head Product Line \- ISEAM
   

  





**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune / Bangalore / Gurgaon
   

  





****Job Responsibilities****




**Job Summary**




 The Product Line, ISEAM organization plays a decisive role in defining the right offers by translating market trends, customer needs and business opportunities into competitive products and solutions. It is responsible for strengthening the competitiveness, profitability and relevance of SKF’s product portfolio across diverse industrial applications.
   

  





 We are looking to identify suitable candidates for the role of Product Manager – Industrial Grease, dedicated to the ISEAM business. The role will be responsible for driving the profitable growth of the Industrial Grease portfolio in ISEAM through clear product strategy, portfolio development, localization, sourcing and go\-to\-market execution, in close alignment with regional and global teams.
   

  





**Key Purpose of the Job**




 To drive profitable growth of the Industrial Grease business in ISEAM by developing and executing product, portfolio, sourcing and go\-to\-market strategies aligned with ISEAM growth priorities, regional objectives and global product line direction.
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




 Develop and execute the Industrial Grease product line strategy for ISEAM, aligned with market opportunities, industry segment priorities, profitability objectives and overall, ISEAM growth strategy.
   

  





 Build and manage a clear product roadmap covering portfolio development, new product introductions, product enhancements, lifecycle management and end\-of\-life planning.
   

  





 Define and strengthen the Industrial Grease portfolio for ISEAM by identifying gaps, prioritizing offers, optimizing assortment and improving product line competitiveness across target segments and channels.
   

  





 Drive profitable business growth across relevant Industrial channels by working closely with sales, application engineering, supply chain and global product line teams to convert market opportunities into scalable offers.
   

  





 Lead localization and sourcing initiatives by identifying ISEAM\-specific requirements, supporting product testing and validation, developing local supply chain capability and improving cost competitiveness.
   

  





 Bring an outside\-in perspective by tracking customer needs, market trends, competitor dynamics and industry developments, and translating these insights into product strategy, value propositions and business cases.
   

  





 Collaborate with regional and global teams to align on strategic focus areas, leverage global capabilities and drive projects that support growth and competitiveness in ISEAM.
   

  





 Prepare and present business cases, portfolio reviews, performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management.
   

  





****Job Requirements****




 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business Administration; MBA or advanced degree will be an advantage.
   

  





 Minimum 8\+ years of experience across sales, application engineering, strategy or product management, with sales experience being mandatory.
   

  





 At least 5\+ years of experience in an industrial grease\-selling multinational organization in ISEAM.
   

  





 Strong understanding of Industrial Grease portfolios, applications, technical product aspects and customer requirements.
   

  





 Strong understanding of the ISEAMn Industrial Grease market, including competitive dynamics, customer segments and channel landscape.
   

  





 Proven track record in sales, business development, product strategy or portfolio management.
   

  





 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to build business cases and make commercially sound decisions.
   

  





 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to collect, interpret and visualize complex data to support strategy and decision\-making.
   

  





 Strategic thinker with an outside\-in mindset and the ability to translate market insights into practical growth actions.
   

  





 Strong collaboration, facilitation, influencing and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix and cross\-functional environment.
   

  





 Proactive, open\-minded team player with the ability to drive change, inspire others and influence stakeholders at different levels.
   

  





 Interested, please share your updated profile – prachi.chourasia@skf.com
   

  





****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Performance Marketing & Growth Lead
description:
Meta Ads • Google Ads • Amazon Ads • Quick Commerce
 
**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time \| Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 3–7 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹50,000–₹80,000/month \+ performance incentives
 **up to ₹5 lakh**



 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **performance marketer who is obsessed with numbers, experiments and growth.** 




**Someone who doesn't just know how to** 
*run Meta Ads* 
 — but understands
 **why an ad wins, why it loses, how many creatives to test, which audiences to explore, when to kill an ad, when to scale it, and how to turn paid acquisition into a predictable growth engine. Meta should be your deepest area of expertise** 
 .
 



 You should have experience scaling a brand or working with an agency where you have managed significant budgets and contributed to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue** 
 or equivalent scale, with a strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, contribution margin and profitability.
 



  




 What you'll own:
 
  




 1\. META ADS — THIS IS YOUR CORE JOB
 
 You will own the entire Meta performance engine.
 



 Not just campaign execution.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Campaign architecture and account structure
* Prospecting vs retargeting strategy
* Audience discovery
* Broad vs interest vs lookalike strategies
* Creative testing frameworks
* Hook testing
* Copy testing
* Offer testing
* Landing\-page testing
* Budget allocation
* Campaign scaling
* Retargeting
* Frequency management
* CAC / ROAS optimisation
* Attribution analysis
* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly growth analysis



  





 You should be able to answer questions like:
 


**How many creatives should we launch this week?** 
**Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?** 
**When do you kill an ad?** 
**When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?** 
**Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?** 
**Why did CPM increase?** 
**Why is CTR falling?** 
**Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?** 
**What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?** 

  





  




 2\. Build a creative testing machine:
 
 You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.
 



 You will decide:
 


* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed



 For example:
 



**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers** 




 should not be random experimentation.
 


 You should be able to build a
 **structured testing matrix** 
 and understand which variable is actually driving performance.
 
  





**3\. Creative Intelligence** 




 You won't just consume creatives.
 



 You'll help
 **create them.** 




 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation



 You should be capable of saying:
 



 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.



**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Sales Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Purpose
 



  





 The Regional Manager \- HVAC \& Ventilation Systems will be responsible for developing KOHMER as a preferred air\-movement and ventilation solutions brand within the assigned territory.
 



 The position combines technical HVAC knowledge, specification selling, consultant engagement, OEM development and project\-based business development. The candidate will understand customer requirements involving airflow, static pressure, efficiency, acoustics, motor/control technology and application conditions, and work with KOHMER's engineering team to propose technically and commercially appropriate fan and ventilation solutions.
 



 The role supports KOHMER's portfolio across EC/AC fans, centrifugal and plenum solutions, industrial axial fans, cabinet plug fans, fan wheels and related air\-movement applications for HVAC, AHUs, data centres, industrial ventilation, cooling and process applications.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Regional Business Development
 



 • Develop and execute the regional business plan for KOHMER ventilation products.
 



 • Identify HVAC and industrial projects at concept, design, tender and execution stages and build a healthy opportunity pipeline.
 



 • Take ownership of lead generation, technical\-commercial proposals, negotiations, order conversion and account development.
 



 2\. Consultant \& Specification Development
 



 • Build strong relationships with MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, architects, PMC/EPC organizations and design engineers.
 



 • Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations and design discussions to establish KOHMER products in consultant specifications, approved vendor lists and project schedules.
 



 • Track projects from initial specification through tendering, contractor selection and final order conversion.
 



 3\. HVAC OEM \& AHU Business
 



 • Develop strategic relationships with AHU manufacturers and OEMs, HVAC equipment manufacturers, system integrators, ventilation contractors, MEP contractors, data\-centre solution providers and industrial equipment manufacturers.
 



 • Identify opportunities for product standardization and recurring/OEM business rather than relying only on individual project sales.
 



 4\. Technical Solution Selling
 



 • Interpret project requirements including airflow, static pressure, fan efficiency, acoustic requirements, operating temperature, space limitations, motor/control requirements and installation configuration.
 



 • Coordinate with KOHMER engineering/application teams for fan selection, technical submittals, drawings and performance data.
 



 • Support commercial HVAC and industrial ventilation applications involving EC fans, plenum/plug fans, centrifugal/backward\-curved fans and industrial axial fans.
 



 5\. Project \& Application Development
 



 • Develop opportunities across commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, data centres, pharmaceutical facilities, food processing, hospitals, cleanrooms, industrial plants, cooling systems, railway/mobility applications and process ventilation.
 



 • Explore broader industrial applications including chemical, mining, textile, paper \& pulp, tunnel ventilation and air\-pollution\-control systems where relevant.
 



 6\. Key Account Management
 



 • Identify and develop strategic accounts with long\-term business potential.
 



 • Establish account plans for consultants, OEMs, contractors and major end users.
 



 • Maintain disciplined follow\-up from enquiry through technical approval, quotation, negotiation, purchase order, delivery and post\-sales coordination.
 



 7\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 



 • Own the assigned region's Order Intake, Revenue, Gross Margin, Collections and Pipeline.
 



 • Prepare monthly forecasts and maintain CRM\-based opportunity tracking.
 



 • Monitor pricing, competition and market trends while maintaining commercial discipline.
 



 8\. Market \& Competition Intelligence
 



 • Monitor competing fan and ventilation technologies, pricing, consultant preferences and emerging HVAC requirements.
 



 • Provide structured feedback to management regarding product gaps, new\-product opportunities, regional pricing and application trends.
 



 9\. Technical Marketing \& Brand Development
 



 • Represent KOHMER at ISHRAE/ASHRAE programs, HVAC conferences, exhibitions, technical seminars, consultant meets and industry forums.
 



 • Conduct technical sessions for consultants and customers on fan selection, EC/PM technology, energy\-efficient ventilation, acoustics and system optimization.
 



 10\. Site \& Project Coordination
 



 • Conduct project/site visits to understand installation conditions and coordinate technical requirements between customers, contractors and the factory/application engineering team.
 



 • Support troubleshooting and ensure effective technical\-commercial closure of project issues.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred. Diploma Mechanical candidates with strong relevant HVAC/fan experience may also be considered. MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an advantage.
 



 Experience: Ideally 5\-10 years in HVAC, ventilation, fans, AHUs, air movement, industrial ventilation or related engineered products.
 



 Market Exposure: Preference for candidates with demonstrated relationships among HVAC/MEP consultants, AHU manufacturers, contractors, OEMs and industrial customers.
 



 Essential Technical Knowledge
 



 Airflow (CMH/CFM) \| Static/Total Pressure \| Fan Curves \| Fan Selection \| Fan Efficiency \| System Resistance \| RPM \| Motor Power \| EC/PM/AC Motors \| VFD Controls \| Axial Fans \| Centrifugal/Backward\-Curved Fans \| Plenum/Plug Fans \| Acoustics/Noise \| AHU Applications \| Supply/Exhaust Ventilation
 



 Exposure to AMCA 210 / ISO 5801 fan\-performance concepts and testing practices will be particularly valuable.
 



 Key Competencies
 



 • Technical credibility combined with strong commercial drive.
 



 • Ability to discuss fan performance and system requirements confidently with HVAC consultants and design engineers.
 



 • Strong B2B project\-sales, negotiation, presentation and networking capability.
 



 • Disciplined project tracking, CRM usage, forecasting and reporting.
 



 • Independent working style with strong internal collaboration and ownership.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently for consultant, customer, OEM and project/site meetings.**

 Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next\-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high\-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high\-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.
   

  

 With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high\-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench\-assisted planar technology to provide industry\-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium\-voltage grid and infrastructure applications.
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Technical Marketing Engineer
 **,** 
 to join our fast\-growing
 **Silicon Carbide (SiC) Business Unit** 
 . The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, energetic, and able to thrive in a high\-growth, innovative environment, contributing directly to technologies that are shaping the future of power electronics.

* Comfort reading data and M\&E reports and mining them for content ideas and proof points.

Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager with 8\+ years in B2B marketing operations to own campaign execution and lead lifecycle management across our martech stack. You'll bring an AI\-first approach to the role, using AI tools to speed up campaign builds, QA, and reporting, while working hands\-on in Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, and Qualified. **Marketing Automation \& CRM Operations**
* Manage Marketo\-Salesforce sync, Salesforce campaign structures, and attribution reporting

**Data Governance \& Reporting**
* Maintain data hygiene, deduplication, and segmentation standards with SalesOps
* Build and maintain dashboards tracking funnel conversion (MEL, MQL to Opportunity), influenced pipeline, and ROI in Salesforce and other supporting systems.
* Turn campaign and funnel data into recommendations that improve conversion and efficiency


**Process \& Martech Management**
* Document SOPs and playbooks; automate manual work where possible
* Support the broader martech stack (webinar platforms, enrichment, intent tools) and evaluate new capabilities


**What We Are Looking For**
* 8\+ years in marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation
* Hands\-on expertise in Marketo and Salesforce
* AI\-first mindset \- comfortable using AI tools to speed up campaign execution, QA, and reporting
* Strong grasp of lead scoring, lifecycle, routing, segmentation, and nurture strategy
* Experience building performance dashboards and reporting on integrated, omnichannel and multithreading campaigns
* Sharp attention to detail, strong project management skills, and comfort managing multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Skills**
* Background in B2B SaaS or data\-driven organizations
* Familiarity with ZoomInfo, 6sense, or similar enrichment/intent platforms
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, and marketing data flows
* Exposure to attribution and revenue reporting frameworks; basic SQL a plus


**Why HG Insights**
* Own end\-to\-end campaign execution with direct impact on pipeline and revenue
* Build expertise in martech and scalable marketing systems
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to drive data\-led GTM decisions
* Enjoy a holistic compensation package that rewards performance and potential, encompassing competitive salary, incentives (bonus and equity), comprehensive benefits, and career development.
* A “Plan, Do, Check, Act” environment that embraces remote work while empowering ingenuity, collaboration, ownership, and achievement.


**What We Offer/Benefits**
 We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.
   

  

 We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

title: Business Head – Aqua
description:
**Company Description** 
 HUVEPHARMA SEA (PUNE) PRIVATE LIMITED is part of Huvepharma®, a global company that invests in environmentally friendly technologies and operates with a strong commitment to ecological responsibility across the entire production cycle. This focus on accountable resource and waste management positions the organization as a leader in sustainable livestock and aqua solutions. The company’s green credentials in manufacturing, marketing, and sales make it a trusted upstream partner for businesses seeking to improve efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Its products are designed to enhance production performance in livestock and aquaculture while lowering the carbon footprint for customers. Candidates joining HUVEPHARMA can expect to work in a purpose\-driven environment aligned with sustainability and long\-term value creation.
 



  





 JOB DESCRIPTION
 



**Position:** 
 Business Head – Aqua
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra
 



**Department:** 
 Aqua Business
 



**Industry:** 
 Animal Health / Aquaculture / Aqua Feed
 



 1\. Job Purpose
 



 To lead and develop the company's Aqua business by driving revenue growth, market expansion, customer development, product positioning, and profitability across aquaculture markets.
 



 The Business Head – Aqua will be responsible for developing and executing the overall Aqua business strategy, building strong relationships with key customers and channel partners, leading the sales and technical team, and identifying new opportunities in
 **aquaculture health, nutrition, aqua feed, feed additives and related products** 
 .
 



 2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Business Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and implement the overall business strategy for the Aqua division in line with organizational objectives.
* Prepare annual business plans, sales targets, budgets and growth strategies for the Aqua business.
* Identify new markets, products, customers and business opportunities for sustainable growth.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing and customer requirements.
* Drive revenue, market share and profitability of the Aqua business.
* Establish short\-term and long\-term business development plans for the Aqua segment.



 B. Sales \& Business Development
 


* Lead and drive Aqua sales across assigned territories and markets.
* Develop business with shrimp farmers, fish farmers, hatcheries, feed mills, distributors, dealers, consultants and institutional customers.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers and strategic accounts.
* Identify and appoint suitable distributors/dealers and strengthen the existing distribution network.
* Explore opportunities for expansion into new geographical markets.
* Negotiate commercial terms with key customers and channel partners within approved company guidelines.
* Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.



 C. Aqua Feed \& Nutrition Business
 


* Develop business opportunities related to
 **aqua feed, feed additives, nutritional products and feed solutions** 
 .
* Build relationships with aqua feed manufacturers, feed mills and major aquaculture customers.
* Understand customer requirements related to feed quality, nutrition, performance, feed conversion and farm economics.
* Identify opportunities for introducing new feed products, feed additives and nutritional solutions.
* Coordinate with technical and product teams for product demonstrations, trials and field evaluations.
* Monitor developments in the aqua feed market, including new products, technologies, formulations and competitor activities.
* Develop strategies to increase penetration of the company's products in the aqua feed and aquaculture nutrition segment.



 D. Technical \& Customer Support
 


* Provide leadership and direction for technical support to Aqua customers.
* Coordinate farm visits, product trials, demonstrations and technical seminars.
* Support customers in identifying and resolving aquaculture\-related technical issues.
* Work closely with veterinarians, aqua specialists, consultants and technical teams.
* Collect market feedback and communicate customer requirements to Product Development, Technical, Marketing and Management teams.
* Ensure proper technical positioning and application of company products.



 E. Team Management
 


* Lead, mentor and develop the Aqua sales and technical team.
* Set individual and team targets and monitor performance.
* Conduct regular business reviews with the team.
* Develop team capabilities through product, technical and selling\-skills training.
* Ensure effective territory planning, customer coverage and reporting.
* Support recruitment and development of competent Aqua professionals.



 F. Marketing \& Market Development
 


* Develop and implement Aqua marketing plans in coordination with the Marketing team.
* Organize customer meetings, technical seminars, farmer meetings, conferences and exhibitions.
* Develop product positioning and market communication strategies.
* Support preparation of technical literature, product presentations and promotional materials.
* Build the company's brand presence within the aquaculture industry.



 G. Business Monitoring \& Reporting
 


* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual business reports.
* Monitor sales achievement, gross margins, expenses, collections and profitability.
* Prepare sales forecasts and business projections.
* Track market developments, competitor pricing and product launches.
* Present business performance and action plans to senior management.
* Ensure timely submission of CRM, sales and market reports.



 3\. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
 


* Achievement of Aqua sales and revenue targets
* Business growth and profitability
* Aqua feed/feed additive business development
* New customer and distributor acquisition
* Market expansion and geographical coverage
* Key account development
* Customer retention and satisfaction
* Product trials and successful commercialization
* Team productivity and target achievement
* Collection/receivables management
* New product/business opportunity development
* Competitor and market intelligence



 4\. Candidate Profile
 



**Education:** 



* Bachelor's/Master's degree in
 **Aquaculture, Fisheries, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Agriculture, Food Technology, Animal Nutrition** 
 or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing/Business Management will be an added advantage.



**Required Experience:** 



* **15\+ years of overall experience** 
 in the aquaculture industry, preferably in
 **Aqua Health, Aqua Feed, Feed Additives, Aqua Nutrition or related businesses** 
 .
* Candidates should have substantial experience in
 **Aqua Feed / Feed Additives / Aquaculture Nutrition** 
 , preferably with an established feed manufacturer, aqua nutrition company, animal health company or related organization.
* Minimum
 **5–7 years of experience in a business leadership / senior sales / business development role** 
 with responsibility for revenue and team management.
* Strong experience in
 **Shrimp/Fish farming, Aqua Feed, Feed Mills, Hatcheries and Aqua distribution channels** 
 will be preferred.
* Experience in developing and managing distributors, dealers, key accounts and institutional customers.
* Proven experience in launching products and developing new markets.
* Strong understanding of the Indian aquaculture and aqua feed market.



 5\. Key Competencies
 


* Business leadership and strategic thinking
* Aqua industry knowledge
* Aqua feed \& nutrition understanding
* Sales \& business development
* Channel management
* Key account management
* Team leadership
* Negotiation and commercial skills
* Customer relationship management
* Market intelligence
* Analytical and financial understanding
* Communication and presentation skills
* Result orientation
* Willingness to travel extensively



 If anyone interested please share resume at shreya.das@huvepharma.com

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
   

  

 The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
   

  

 This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross\-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.

**About Springer Nature**
 Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology\-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature.
   

  

**About The Brand**
 Nature Portfolio’s high\-quality journals and services across the life, physical, chemical and applied sciences help move science and society forward.
   

  

 Nature Portfolio is home to the leading, international weekly journal of science, Nature – founded in 1869\. It is also home to the Nature research and Nature Reviews journals, the leading open access multidisciplinary journal
 *Nature Communications* 
 , and open access journals including
 *Scientific Reports* 
 . Together, these journals publish some of the world's most significant scientific discoveries.
   

  

 Online, nature.com provides over nine million unique visitors per month with content, including news and comment from the Nature journal, and the leading scientific jobs board, Nature Careers. As part of Springer Nature, Nature Portfolio also offers a range of researcher services, including online and in\-person training. For more information, please visit nature.com and follow @NaturePortfolio.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an Associate Publisher to manage a portfolio of proprietary and society open access journals published under the npj brand. The npjs are fully open\-access Nature Portfolio academic journals that together span a wide range of research, from fundamental physics to clinical research to engineering. Each npj is targeted to a specific scientific community and is launched and run in collaboration with preeminent scientists. Reporting to an Executive Publisher you will be responsible for the management, strategic development and success of the individual journals within the Clinical Medicine field. This role involves liaising with internal staff, external journal editors, and the scientific community.

* Attend external meetings (in\-person or virtual) to build close working relationships with external EiCs, EBMs, society partners and the wider research community, using Market Intelligence, Business Development and Persuasion to understand stakeholder needs and identify opportunities for journal development.

* Positive and proactive approach to problem solving, taking ownership to drive and complete tasks

* Experience developing and maintaining productive and friendly relations/partnerships with academic and industry\-based researchers
* Strong time management and organizational skills; including proven ability to take ownership to drive and complete tasks, to consistently meet deadlines, and to adapt quickly to change

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
* 🌴
 **Time Off:** 
 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
 VOPA is looking for a Manager, Social Media and Communications, to lead the strategy, storytelling and brand\-building for our work across education, mental health, life\-skills and technology\-for\-good. This is not a content\-posting role: it requires someone who understands the science behind social media (algorithms, audience behaviour, analytics) and who can independently grasp the substance of any VOPA project, whether it is a literacy assessment, a de\-addiction programme, or a teacher mental\-health initiative. Deep prior knowledge is not required, but the candidate must be curious enough to ask why, when, where, who and how before turning field work into a post, and confident enough to judge what is worth telling on LinkedIn or Instagram. This person will build VOPA into a recognised, credible brand in the education and social impact space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and drive VOPA's social media and communications strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms, aligned with organisational and project goals.
* Before developing any content, understand the project (purpose, context, target group, impact) by asking the right questions: why this intervention, when and why it started, who it serves, what has changed.
* Translate technical and programmatic work (assessments, field data, research, government partnerships) from verticals such as NIPUN Maharashtra, Saiyam, MYCA and Digital Learning into content that is accurate, compelling and easy for a public audience to follow.
* Apply an understanding of platform algorithms and audience behaviour to decide what to post, when, and in what format, rather than following a generic content calendar.
* Plan, create, edit, publish and manage a consistent content calendar (text, graphics, reels, videos, stories) that reflects VOPA's voice and priorities.
* Coordinate with programme, field and research teams to source real stories, data, testimonials, photographs and videos, and verify facts before they go out publicly.
* Track reach, engagement and growth metrics, benchmark against comparable organisations, and report impact regularly to leadership.
* Maintain brand consistency (visual identity, tone of voice, messaging) across all social media accounts, collateral and external communication.
* Support donor and partner visibility needs, including acknowledgement posts, event coverage, and inputs for annual reports and case studies.
* Guide and review the work of any social media or design associates, interns or freelancers supporting the function.
* Maintain and submit monthly and quarterly communications reports, content plans and expense records.


**Qualifications**
 A bachelor's or master's degree in mass communication, journalism, marketing, digital media, social work or a related field. Certifications in social media marketing, analytics or graphic design will be an advantage.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in social media management and/or communications, with at least part of this in the development sector, non\-profit space or a mission\-driven organisation.
* Demonstrated experience independently building and executing a social media or communications strategy, not only running content calendars set by others.
* Proven ability to understand unfamiliar subject matter quickly and translate it into public\-facing content.
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team members, interns or freelance designers is preferred.


**Skills**
* Strong grasp of the science of social media: platform algorithms, analytics, audience segmentation and what drives genuine engagement, not just likes.
* Ability to grasp the substance of diverse projects (education, de\-addiction, mental health, technology) with limited prior knowledge, by asking structured questions (why, when, where, who, how) and applying that logic to content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; working knowledge of Marathi and/or Hindi is an advantage.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent design tools, and basic video/reel editing.
* Comfort reading data and M\&E reports and mining them for content ideas and proof points.
* Analytical mindset, able to set metrics, track performance and adapt strategy based on what the data shows.


**Values**
 Curiosity, discipline, drive for social action, integrity, hard work, and ownership of the VOPA brand.
   

  

**Office Location:** 
 Kothrud, Pune
   

  

**Salary: Rs. 6,00,000 to Rs. 9,00,000 per annum (CTC), depending on experience and fit.**
**How to Apply: Fill out the form at**
**Website:** 
 https://careers.vopa.in/
   

  

**Email:** 
 hr.vopa@vopa.in
   

  

 Salary Range
   

  

 6\.00 \- 9\.00 LPA
